b3_p1_coordinator_restart_no_remint.harness: manual replication of b3 steps 3-4 (no invite mint) after systemctl restart of the coordinator
b3_p1_coordinator_restart_no_remint.note: S77 blocker did NOT reproduce end-to-end, BUT the boot window it stems from was OBSERVED: after restart the coordinator REJECTED the worker's incoming sync (iroh_docs Aborted ... NotFound, ~26s into boot #2) exactly as the A3 preflight predicted (open_doc does not start_sync). Delivery then succeeded ONLY because the task-submit path side-effects share_write() in the on-demand local-worker bootstrap (local_worker.rs:306-310) BEFORE its spawn fails on the anchor (worker binary absent) — re-arming the sync-set on every submit. Precondition: 're-arming on EVERY submit' holds only WHILE the spawn keeps failing (child never set -> ensure_spawned re-provisions each time); a successfully spawned local worker arms only once per daemon lifetime. This refines preflight §2.2, which filed share_write under 'invite mint only' and missed the submit-path trigger (http.rs:3459 ensure_spawned). The boot->first-submit window remains a real convergence hole and the delivery path depends on a fragile side-effect: both are the A3b target.
b3_p1_coordinator_restart_no_remint.boot_window_evidence: journal nodeVPS boot#2: 'sync failed origin=Accept err=Aborted sync of NamespaceId(35701c15..) .. NotFound' then submit -> 'failed to spawn on-demand local worker' (share_write already done) -> accept 'sync finished sent=7 recv=8' 300ms later
b3_p1_coordinator_restart_no_remint.a3b_differential_contract: this palier is already PASS via the submit side-effect, so a post-A3b PASS alone proves nothing; the A3b differential criterion is the WINDOW disappearing: after coordinator restart and BEFORE any submit, the worker's incoming sync must be ACCEPTED (no 'Aborted sync .. NotFound' in the coordinator journal). The preflight §2.2 static theory (reject until share) matched the boot window exactly; its miss was the submit-side share_write side-effect.
